overview: No anti-cheat consumes S34. The corpus sweep for S34PacketMaps and PacketPlayOutMap returns only keyword noise from the chunk family: Artemis' HardcodeMap generator and its GPacketPlayServerChunkLoad and GPacketPlayServerChunkLoadBulk wrappers match on the PacketPlayOutMapChunk class names, and Kauri's BlockUpdateHandler Javadoc mentions a wrapped map-chunk packet. None of these read map item data. S34 is pure render state for players holding or standing near a map, with no movement, combat or inventory signal, so no check in any cloned anticheat references it.
